facts.text: I am preparing to move to Vancouver for my Master's program at UBC.
I submitted my student visa application on April 1st.
I was automatically enrolled in iMED when I register for my courses.
I will arrive in Vancouver to apply for BC MSP.
I want a list of recommended doctors or medical clinics near the UBC campus that accept international students with iMED or MSP coverage.
I want to open a bank account in Canada with my study permit.
I will look into opening a bank account once I arrive in Vancouver.
I am assuming I will be able to open a bank account with my study permit.
I want to get a Canadian phone number and set up internet services in my new apartment.
I want to know the cost of living in Vancouver, especially for food and transportation.
I have heard that Vancouver is quite expensive.
I want to budget for food and transportation costs in Vancouver.

keyphrases: open a bank account in Canada
